ActorTalk: That's what the results say. There's no second interpretation either.
That can't be right! Check it again!
The simulation has run over 7 iterations. The sample data structures, the data, the verifications, and the semantic mapping... everything is consistent.
Impossible... IMPOSSIBLE! This should be the seed phrase for a hardware wallet! It's supposed to contain a bunch of assets from the Golden Age!
What's going on?
As you might've heard, this person possesses a piece of Kuroro code, and he believed it contained vast riches, which is what led to all those incidents.
But after running my simulation, this code contains no gold, silver, or jewels. There's only a passage that resembles a blessing—
"Congratulations, if you're reading this, it means you've mastered this encoding technique. This is the most precious treasure I've left you."
Why... why?! WHY!
How could the code my dad left behind possibly be something like this?!!
The words your father left behind...
He's just trying to encourage you.
Doesn't seem problematic to me.
What do you know! Do you have any idea how much I sacrificed to figure out this code!
I used to be a top student at F.O.S. College, but my mentor gave up on me just because I chose this path.
My partner supported me at first, but after standing by my side for so long... she couldn't take it anymore and left.
Friendship, love, my mentorship... everything was ruined! And now, you want to tell me this code was just a blessing?!
This was your own choice.
This isn't what I wanted! My father exploited my curiosity and trust! He steered my life in the direction he thought was right!
Damn it! I could've become rich, but there he was, telling me to be a good student and to become some scientist! You think I'm a child or something?! This just isn't right! You're wrong, Asimov!
Enough. All this complaining is pointless. You should use this time in prison to seriously think about how to use that technology of yours to make an honest living.
What is it?
You seem to have something on your mind still.
This person isn't really worth discussing at length, but his situation made me think of another issue.
For humanity, the Punishing Virus, too, is a puzzle laid out before us. All our research, sacrifices, and progress—we're doing all of this to solve it.
But if we really do find the answer we're looking for one of these days, I wonder if it'll turn out to be what we'd hoped for...
